Here we can see that there is a very small number of very bad predictions, with n_sd = 3, there are 8 bad predictions, with n_sd = 2, there are 13 bad predictions, with n_sd = 1, there are 29 bad predictions, with n_sd = 0.5, there are 43 bad predictions. We'll try to look at these results specifically and see how we can improve these predictions. 

We'll first try different models for these predictions
```{r}
evaluate_combo <- function(row_params, df = df_all,
                           target_var = "LotFrontage",
                           mask_frac = 0.20,
                           min_obs_per_level = 10,
                           min_obs_cor = 10,
                           min_obs_anova = 20,
                           min_rows_train = 30,
                           max_mask_attempts = 200,
                           cv_folds = 5,
                           hard_resid_sd_mult = 1.5,
                           specialist_min_rows = 20,
                           specialist_prob_threshold = 0.5,
                           mf_ntree = 100,
                           xgb_nrounds = 100,
                           verbose = FALSE) {
  # Required packages
  requireNamespace("dplyr"); requireNamespace("forcats"); requireNamespace("tibble")
  requireNamespace("purrr"); requireNamespace("missForest"); requireNamespace("xgboost")
  requireNamespace("randomForest")
  library(dplyr); library(forcats); library(tibble); library(purrr)

  # helpers -------------------------------------------------------------------

  # safe rbind that aligns columns and factor levels
  safe_rbind <- function(a, b) {
    all_cols <- union(names(a), names(b))
    add_missing <- function(df, cols) {
      for (cc in cols) if (!(cc %in% names(df))) df[[cc]] <- NA
      df[, cols, drop = FALSE]
    }
    a2 <- add_missing(a, all_cols)
    b2 <- add_missing(b, all_cols)
    # align factor levels
    for (col in all_cols) {
      if (is.factor(a2[[col]]) || is.factor(b2[[col]])) {
        levs <- union(if (is.factor(a2[[col]])) levels(a2[[col]]) else NULL,
                      if (is.factor(b2[[col]])) levels(b2[[col]]) else NULL)
        if (is.factor(a2[[col]])) a2[[col]] <- factor(a2[[col]], levels = levs) else a2[[col]] <- factor(a2[[col]], levels = levs)
        if (is.factor(b2[[col]])) b2[[col]] <- factor(b2[[col]], levels = levs) else b2[[col]] <- factor(b2[[col]], levels = levs)
      }
    }
    rbind(a2, b2)
  }

  # collapse rare levels in specified factor vars (used AFTER masking)
  collapse_rare_levels <- function(df_local, factor_vars, min_obs) {
    for (v in factor_vars) {
      if (! (v %in% names(df_local))) next
      if (!is.factor(df_local[[v]])) next
      tbl <- table(df_local[[v]])
      rare_levels <- names(tbl)[tbl < min_obs]
      if (length(rare_levels) > 0) {
        df_local[[v]] <- forcats::fct_collapse(df_local[[v]], Other = rare_levels)
        df_local[[v]] <- droplevels(df_local[[v]])
      }
    }
    df_local
  }

  # rmse/mae/r2 evaluator
  eval_metrics <- function(true, pred) {
    ok <- !is.na(true) & !is.na(pred)
    if (sum(ok) == 0) return(list(n = 0, RMSE = NA_real_, MAE = NA_real_, R2 = NA_real_))
    t <- true[ok]; p <- pred[ok]
    list(n = sum(ok), RMSE = sqrt(mean((t - p)^2)), MAE = mean(abs(t - p)), R2 = if (length(t) > 1) cor(t, p)^2 else NA_real_)
  }

  # parameters from row
  alpha_cor   <- row_params$alpha_cor %||% row_params$alpha_cor
  alpha_anova <- row_params$alpha_anova %||% row_params$alpha_anova
  # allow mf_ntree from row_params too
  if (!is.null(row_params$mf_ntree)) mf_ntree <- row_params$mf_ntree

  # main tryCatch to ensure consistent return on error
  tryCatch({

    # 1) Predictor selection (unchanged: assuming you have results_table_numeric / anova available)
    selected_numeric <- results_table_numeric$Variable[results_table_numeric$P_value < alpha_cor]
    selected_factors <- results_table_anova$Variable[results_table_anova$P_value < alpha_anova]
    selected_predictors <- c(selected_numeric, selected_factors)

    if (length(selected_predictors) == 0) {
      return(list(metrics_table = tibble::tibble(
        alpha_cor = alpha_cor, alpha_anova = alpha_anova, Method = c("missForest_two_stage", "xgboost"),
        RMSE = NA_real_, MAE = NA_real_, R2 = NA_real_
      ), all_predictions = NULL))
    }

    # 2) Restrict to rows with predictors present (complete cases on predictors)
    predictor_complete_idx <- complete.cases(df[, selected_predictors, drop = FALSE])
    model_df <- df[predictor_complete_idx, c(target_var, selected_predictors), drop = FALSE]

    # 3) Known indices for target
    known_idx <- which(!is.na(model_df[[target_var]]))
    if (length(known_idx) < (min_rows_train + 2)) {
      return(list(metrics_table = tibble::tibble(
        alpha_cor = alpha_cor, alpha_anova = alpha_anova, Method = c("missForest_two_stage", "xgboost"),
        RMSE = NA_real_, MAE = NA_real_, R2 = NA_real_
      ), all_predictions = NULL))
    }

    # 4) Mask selection (keep same logic as before)
    mask_n <- max(1, round(length(known_idx) * mask_frac))
    attempt <- 1
    mask_indices_final <- NULL

    valid_mask <- function(mask_idx, df_model, factor_predictors) {
      train_idx <- setdiff(which(!is.na(df_model[[target_var]])), mask_idx)
      if (length(train_idx) < min_rows_train) return(FALSE)
      for (f in factor_predictors) {
        if (!is.factor(df_model[[f]])) next
        nlev <- nlevels(droplevels(df_model[[f]][train_idx]))
        if (nlev < 2) return(FALSE)
      }
      TRUE
    }
    factor_preds_in_selected <- selected_factors[selected_factors %in% selected_predictors]

    while (attempt <= max_mask_attempts) {
      mask_idx_try <- sample(known_idx, mask_n)
      if (valid_mask(mask_idx_try, model_df, factor_preds_in_selected)) {
        mask_indices_final <- mask_idx_try
        break
      }
      attempt <- attempt + 1
    }
    if (is.null(mask_indices_final)) {
      found <- FALSE
      for (mf_try in seq(mask_frac/2, 0.02, by = -0.01)) {
        mask_n2 <- max(1, round(length(known_idx) * mf_try))
        attempt2 <- 1
        while (attempt2 <= max_mask_attempts) {
          mask_idx_try <- sample(known_idx, mask_n2)
          if (valid_mask(mask_idx_try, model_df, factor_preds_in_selected)) {
            mask_indices_final <- mask_idx_try
            found <- TRUE
            break
          }
          attempt2 <- attempt2 + 1
        }
        if (found) break
      }
    }
    if (is.null(mask_indices_final)) stop("Unable to find a valid mask that preserves factor levels")

    # 5) Prepare masked df, BUT per option B we will collapse rare levels only AFTER masking
    df_model_masked <- model_df
    true_values_orig <- df_model_masked[[target_var]][mask_indices_final]
    df_model_masked[[target_var]][mask_indices_final] <- NA
    train_idx <- which(!is.na(df_model_masked[[target_var]]))
    test_idx  <- mask_indices_final

    # 6) Now collapse rare factor levels on the masked subset (both train + test together)
    factor_vars_here <- intersect(selected_factors, names(df_model_masked))
    if (length(factor_vars_here) > 0) {
      df_model_masked <- collapse_rare_levels(df_model_masked, factor_vars_here, min_obs_per_level)
    }

    # 7) Drop single-level factors / constant numerics after collapsing
    final_predictors <- selected_predictors
    if (length(selected_factors) > 0) {
      for (f in selected_factors) {
        if (f %in% final_predictors) {
          nlev_train <- nlevels(droplevels(df_model_masked[[f]][train_idx]))
          if (nlev_train < 2) final_predictors <- setdiff(final_predictors, f)
        }
      }
    }
    for (nvar in selected_numeric) {
      if (nvar %in% final_predictors) {
        if (var(df_model_masked[[nvar]][train_idx], na.rm = TRUE) == 0) final_predictors <- setdiff(final_predictors, nvar)
      }
    }
    if (length(final_predictors) == 0) stop("No valid predictors remain for modeling after collapsing / dropping constants")

    # 8) Build train/test frames with final_predictors
    train_df_reg <- df_model_masked[train_idx, c(target_var, final_predictors), drop = FALSE]
    test_df_reg  <- df_model_masked[test_idx,  c(target_var, final_predictors), drop = FALSE]

    # align factor levels
    for (f in final_predictors) {
      if (is.factor(train_df_reg[[f]])) {
        levs <- levels(droplevels(train_df_reg[[f]]))
        train_df_reg[[f]] <- factor(train_df_reg[[f]], levels = levs)
        test_df_reg[[f]]  <- factor(test_df_reg[[f]], levels = levs)
      }
    }

    # 9) Create LF_log target column in train; test LF_log is NA
    train_df_reg$LF_log <- log1p(train_df_reg[[target_var]])
    test_df_reg$LF_log <- NA_real_

    # helper to build combined matrix for missForest (train + test)
    build_combined_for_impute <- function(train_block, test_block, keep_cols) {
      # select keep_cols present
      keep_cols_present <- keep_cols[keep_cols %in% names(train_block)]
      train_sel <- train_block[, keep_cols_present, drop = FALSE]
      test_sel  <- test_block[, keep_cols_present, drop = FALSE]
      safe_rbind(train_sel, test_sel)
    }

    # 10) CROSS-VALIDATION on training set to get CV predictions (for residuals)
    ntrain <- nrow(train_df_reg)
    folds <- sample(rep(1:cv_folds, length.out = ntrain))
    cv_pred_train_log <- rep(NA_real_, ntrain)

    # columns to include in imputation: final_predictors + LF_log (LF_log exists in train)
    impute_cols <- c(final_predictors, "LF_log")

    for (k in seq_len(cv_folds)) {
      tr_idx_k <- which(folds != k)
      val_idx_k <- which(folds == k)
      if (length(tr_idx_k) < 5 || length(val_idx_k) < 1) next

      fold_train <- train_df_reg[tr_idx_k, , drop = FALSE]
      fold_val   <- train_df_reg[val_idx_k, , drop = FALSE]

      combined_fold <- build_combined_for_impute(fold_train[, impute_cols, drop = FALSE],
                                                fold_val[, impute_cols, drop = FALSE],
                                                impute_cols)
      # impute LF_log on combined_fold using missForest
      mf_out <- tryCatch(missForest::missForest(combined_fold, maxiter = 5, ntree = mf_ntree, verbose = FALSE),
                         error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(mf_out)) next

      imputed_fold <- mf_out$ximp
      ntr <- nrow(fold_train)
      pred_val_log <- imputed_fold$LF_log[(ntr + 1):nrow(imputed_fold)]
      cv_pred_train_log[val_idx_k] <- pred_val_log
    }

    # if some cv preds missing, fill them by fitting on full train once
    missing_cv <- which(is.na(cv_pred_train_log))
    if (length(missing_cv) > 0) {
      combined_full <- build_combined_for_impute(train_df_reg[, impute_cols, drop = FALSE],
                                                test_df_reg[, impute_cols, drop = FALSE],
                                                impute_cols)
      mf_out_full <- tryCatch(missForest::missForest(combined_full, maxiter = 5, ntree = mf_ntree, verbose = FALSE),
                              error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(mf_out_full)) {
        imputed_full <- mf_out_full$ximp
        cv_train_full <- imputed_full$LF_log[1:nrow(train_df_reg)]
        cv_pred_train_log[missing_cv] <- cv_train_full[missing_cv]
      }
    }

    # 11) compute residuals on original scale and determine hard training rows
    pred_train_orig <- expm1(cv_pred_train_log)
    true_train_orig <- train_df_reg[[target_var]]
    resid_train <- abs(true_train_orig - pred_train_orig)
    resid_mean <- mean(resid_train, na.rm = TRUE)
    resid_sd   <- sd(resid_train, na.rm = TRUE)
    hard_threshold <- resid_mean + hard_resid_sd_mult * resid_sd
    hard_train_idx <- which(resid_train > hard_threshold)

    # relax threshold until we have at least specialist_min_rows (conservative)
    if (length(hard_train_idx) < specialist_min_rows) {
      mult_try <- hard_resid_sd_mult
      while (length(hard_train_idx) < specialist_min_rows && mult_try >= 0.5) {
        mult_try <- mult_try - 0.25
        hard_threshold2 <- resid_mean + mult_try * resid_sd
        hard_train_idx <- which(resid_train > hard_threshold2)
        if (mult_try <= 0.5) break
      }
    }

    # 12) MAIN imputation using missForest (train+test combined)
    combined_main <- build_combined_for_impute(train_df_reg[, impute_cols, drop = FALSE],
                                              test_df_reg[, impute_cols, drop = FALSE],
                                              impute_cols)
    mf_out_main <- tryCatch(missForest::missForest(combined_main, maxiter = 10, ntree = mf_ntree, verbose = FALSE),
                            error = function(e) NULL)
    main_pred_log <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(test_df_reg))
    if (!is.null(mf_out_main)) {
      imputed_main <- mf_out_main$ximp
      ntr <- nrow(train_df_reg)
      main_pred_log <- imputed_main$LF_log[(ntr + 1):nrow(imputed_main)]
    }

    # 13) SPECIALIST imputation (if enough hard rows)
    specialist_pred_log <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(test_df_reg))
    if (length(hard_train_idx) >= 5) {
      spec_train <- train_df_reg[hard_train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
      spec_impute_cols <- c(final_predictors, "LF_log")
      spec_combined <- build_combined_for_impute(spec_train[, spec_impute_cols, drop = FALSE],
                                                 test_df_reg[, spec_impute_cols, drop = FALSE],
                                                 spec_impute_cols)
      mf_out_spec <- tryCatch(missForest::missForest(spec_combined, maxiter = 10, ntree = max(200, mf_ntree), verbose = FALSE),
                              error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(mf_out_spec)) {
        imputed_spec <- mf_out_spec$ximp
        ntr_spec <- nrow(spec_train)
        specialist_pred_log <- imputed_spec$LF_log[(ntr_spec + 1):nrow(imputed_spec)]
      }

      # classifier to route test rows to specialist (random forest)
      is_hard_label <- rep(0, nrow(train_df_reg)); is_hard_label[hard_train_idx] <- 1
      clf_df <- train_df_reg[, final_predictors, drop = FALSE]
      clf_df$is_hard <- factor(is_hard_label)
      # remove zero-variance columns
      keep_cols <- names(clf_df)[sapply(clf_df, function(x) !(is.numeric(x) && var(as.numeric(x), na.rm = TRUE) == 0))]
      clf_df <- clf_df[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
      rf_clf <- tryCatch(randomForest::randomForest(is_hard ~ ., data = clf_df, ntree = 200), error = function(e) NULL)
      use_specialist <- integer(0)
      if (!is.null(rf_clf)) {
        test_clf_df <- test_df_reg[, names(clf_df)[names(clf_df) != "is_hard"], drop = FALSE]
        # align factor levels with training clf_df
        for (f in names(test_clf_df)) if (is.factor(clf_df[[f]])) test_clf_df[[f]] <- factor(test_clf_df[[f]], levels = levels(clf_df[[f]]))
        probs <- tryCatch(predict(rf_clf, newdata = test_clf_df, type = "prob")[, "1"], error = function(e) rep(0, nrow(test_clf_df)))
        use_specialist <- which(probs > specialist_prob_threshold & !is.na(specialist_pred_log))
      }
    }

    # 14) Combine main & specialist predictions, back-transform
    final_pred_log <- main_pred_log
    if (length(use_specialist) > 0) final_pred_log[use_specialist] <- specialist_pred_log[use_specialist]
    final_pred_orig_mf <- expm1(final_pred_log)

    # 15) XGBoost model (single-stage) - train on train_df_reg, predict test_df_reg
    # Prepare model.matrix (one-hot encoding) for numeric + factor predictors
    # Build formula to include only final_predictors
    xgb_train_mat <- tryCatch({
      model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = train_df_reg[, final_predictors, drop = FALSE])
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    xgb_test_mat <- NULL
    xgb_pred_orig <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(test_df_reg))
    if (!is.null(xgb_train_mat)) {
      # ensure same columns/order for test
      xgb_test_mat <- tryCatch({
        model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = test_df_reg[, final_predictors, drop = FALSE])
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(xgb_test_mat)) {
        # align columns
        allcols <- union(colnames(xgb_train_mat), colnames(xgb_test_mat))
        add_missing_mat <- function(mat, cols) {
          for (cname in cols) if (!(cname %in% colnames(mat))) mat <- cbind(mat, setNames(rep(0, nrow(mat)), cname))
          mat[, cols, drop = FALSE]
        }
        xgb_train_mat2 <- add_missing_mat(xgb_train_mat, allcols)
        xgb_test_mat2  <- add_missing_mat(xgb_test_mat, allcols)
        # order columns
        xgb_train_mat2 <- xgb_train_mat2[, allcols, drop = FALSE]
        xgb_test_mat2  <- xgb_test_mat2[, allcols, drop = FALSE]
        # target is LF_log
        y_train_log <- train_df_reg$LF_log
        dtrain <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(data = xgb_train_mat2, label = y_train_log)
        params <- list(objective = "reg:squarederror", eval_metric = "rmse")
        xgb_mod <- tryCatch(xgboost::xgb.train(params = params, data = dtrain, nrounds = xgb_nrounds, verbose = 0), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (!is.null(xgb_mod)) {
          dtest <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(data = xgb_test_mat2)
          pred_xgb_log <- tryCatch(as.numeric(predict(xgb_mod, dtest)), error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(test_df_reg)))
          xgb_pred_orig <- expm1(pred_xgb_log)
        }
      }
    }

    # 16) Compose predictions tibble and compute metrics
    all_predictions <- tibble::tibble(
      index = test_idx,
      true = true_values_orig,
      pred_missForest_two_stage = final_pred_orig_mf,
      pred_xgboost = xgb_pred_orig
    )

    res_mf <- eval_metrics(true_values_orig, all_predictions$pred_missForest_two_stage)
    res_xgb <- eval_metrics(true_values_orig, all_predictions$pred_xgboost)

    metrics_table <- tibble::tibble(
      alpha_cor = alpha_cor,
      alpha_anova = alpha_anova,
      mf_ntree = mf_ntree,
      xgb_nrounds = xgb_nrounds,
      Method = c("missForest_two_stage", "xgboost"),
      RMSE = c(res_mf$RMSE, res_xgb$RMSE),
      MAE  = c(res_mf$MAE, res_xgb$MAE),
      R2   = c(res_mf$R2, res_xgb$R2),
      n_predictors = length(final_predictors)
    )

    # return requested outputs: best prediction per method? we return per-method predictions + metrics
    return(list(
      metrics_table = metrics_table,
      all_predictions = all_predictions
    ))

  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("evaluate_combo failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    tib <- tibble::tibble(
      alpha_cor = if (exists("alpha_cor")) alpha_cor else NA_real_,
      alpha_anova = if (exists("alpha_anova")) alpha_anova else NA_real_,
      mf_ntree = if (exists("mf_ntree")) mf_ntree else NA_integer_,
      xgb_nrounds = if (exists("xgb_nrounds")) xgb_nrounds else NA_integer_,
      Method = c("missForest_two_stage", "xgboost"),
      RMSE = NA_real_, MAE = NA_real_, R2 = NA_real_, n_predictors = NA_integer_
    )
    return(list(metrics_table = tib, all_predictions = NULL))
  })
}

results_list <- purrr::map(param_list, evaluate_combo, df = train_csv)
# collect metrics:
metrics_all <- purrr::map_dfr(results_list, ~ .x$metrics_table)
# collect predictions (list per combo):
preds_all <- purrr::map(results_list, ~ .x$all_predictions)

best_by_combo <- metrics_all %>%
  group_by(alpha_cor, alpha_anova, mf_ntree, xgb_nrounds, Method) %>%
  summarise(RMSE = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(RMSE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

print(best_by_combo)
```
This updated method produces a very similar result, (R2 = 0.69, RMSe = 11.4), although not a better one. Also xgboost works really well, almost as well as missForest on this dataset. 

We'll next try to see if the model can be fit on the errors present in the inaccurate predictions. If the errors are representative of some underlying pattern, this can improve the predictions by fitting for these specific patterns. However, this method is prone to some level of overfitting, so we'll check using cross-validation to ensure that any improvement we see in prediction accuracy is due to the updated model fitting patterns in the errors and not noise within the error terms.
```{r}
refine_imputation_cv_rf <- function(df_all,
                                    best_prediction,
                                    predictors,
                                    target_var = "LotFrontage",
                                    k = 10,
                                    ntree = 100,
                                    nodesize = 5,
                                    numeric_top_n = 5,
                                    seed = 123,
                                    verbose = TRUE) {
  # Dependencies
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(dplyr)
    library(randomForest)
    library(ggplot2)
  })
  set.seed(seed)

  # --- Sanity checks -------------------------------------------------------
  required_cols <- c("pred", "true", "index")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(best_prediction))) {
    stop("best_prediction must contain columns: 'pred', 'true', 'index'.")
  }
  if (!all(best_prediction$index %in% seq_len(nrow(df_all)))) {
    stop("Some indices in best_prediction$index are not valid row indices in df_all.")
  }

  # Observed indices and vectors (aligned to best_prediction order)
  obs_idx <- best_prediction$index
  preds_obs <- best_prediction$pred
  true_obs  <- best_prediction$true
  n_obs <- length(obs_idx)
  if (n_obs < k) stop("Number of folds k must be <= number of observed rows.")

  # Prepare full-length vectors (aligned to df_all) for diagnostic function
  n_all <- nrow(df_all)
  preds_full <- rep(NA_real_, n_all)
  true_full  <- rep(NA_real_, n_all)
  preds_full[obs_idx] <- preds_obs
  true_full[obs_idx]  <- true_obs

  # Run your diagnostic function (expects full-length vectors)
  diagnostic <- analyse_bad_predictions(
    df_all = df_all,
    predictions = preds_full,
    true_values = true_full,
    predictors = predictors,
    n_sd = 0.5,
    p_thresh = 0.1
  )

  # --- Choose problem variables (from diagnostic) -------------------------
  problem_vars <- character(0)

  if (!is.null(diagnostic$numeric_summary) && nrow(diagnostic$numeric_summary) > 0) {
    ordered_nums <- diagnostic$numeric_summary %>%
      arrange(desc(abs(Mean_Diff))) %>%
      pull(Variable)
    problem_vars <- c(problem_vars, head(ordered_nums, numeric_top_n))
  }
  if (!is.null(diagnostic$factor_summary) && length(diagnostic$factor_summary) > 0) {
    problem_vars <- c(problem_vars, names(diagnostic$factor_summary))
  }
  problem_vars <- unique(problem_vars)
  # Fallback to the full predictors if diagnostic gave nothing usable
  if (length(problem_vars) == 0) {
    if (verbose) message("Diagnostic did not flag variables — using all predictors.")
    problem_vars <- predictors
  } else {
    # ensure problem_vars exist in predictors
    problem_vars <- intersect(problem_vars, predictors)
    if (length(problem_vars) == 0) {
      if (verbose) message("Problem vars were not found in provided predictors — using all predictors.")
      problem_vars <- predictors
    }
  }

  # --- Build modeling dataframe for observed rows --------------------------
  df_obs <- df_all[obs_idx, problem_vars, drop = FALSE] %>% as.data.frame()
  df_obs$.residual <- preds_obs - true_obs  # r = pred - true

  # --- k-fold cross-validation (OOF predictions for the residuals) -------
  folds <- sample(rep(seq_len(k), length.out = n_obs))
  oof_pred_residual <- rep(NA_real_, n_obs)   # predicted residuals out-of-fold
  oof_pred_corrected <- rep(NA_real_, n_obs)  # corrected predictions out-of-fold

  for (fold in seq_len(k)) {
    train_idx <- which(folds != fold)
    val_idx   <- which(folds == fold)

    train_x <- df_obs[train_idx, problem_vars, drop = FALSE]
    train_y <- df_obs$.residual[train_idx]

    val_x <- df_obs[val_idx, problem_vars, drop = FALSE]

    # Train a restrained random forest on residuals
    rf_model <- randomForest(x = train_x, y = train_y, ntree = ntree, nodesize = nodesize)

    # Predict residuals on validation fold
    pred_res_val <- predict(rf_model, val_x)

    # store OOF predictions
    oof_pred_residual[val_idx] <- pred_res_val
    # corrected predictions on validation fold (in best_prediction order)
    oof_pred_corrected[val_idx] <- preds_obs[val_idx] - pred_res_val
  }

  # --- CV metrics (on observed rows, using OOF predictions) ----------------
  rmse_before <- sqrt(mean((preds_obs - true_obs)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  rmse_after_oof <- sqrt(mean((oof_pred_corrected - true_obs)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  improvement_oof <- rmse_before - rmse_after_oof

  if (verbose) {
    cat(sprintf("OOF CV: RMSE before = %.4f; after (OOF corrected) = %.4f; Δ = %.4f\n",
                rmse_before, rmse_after_oof, improvement_oof))
  }

  # --- Train final meta-model on all observed rows -------------------------
  final_rf <- randomForest(x = df_obs[, problem_vars, drop = FALSE],
                           y = df_obs$.residual,
                           ntree = ntree,
                           nodesize = nodesize)

  # Predict correction for all rows in df_all (will return NA for rows where model.matrix fails,
  # but randomForest supports factors so it's fine if df_all has same factor levels).
  df_all_sub <- df_all[, problem_vars, drop = FALSE] %>% as.data.frame()
  final_correction_full <- tryCatch({
    predict(final_rf, newdata = df_all_sub)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # if predict fails (rare), produce NA vector
    warning("Predicting final correction on full data failed: ", e$message)
    rep(NA_real_, n_all)
  })

  # Build corrected predictions
  corrected_full <- preds_full - final_correction_full   # only where preds_full not NA will be meaningful
  corrected_obs <- corrected_full[obs_idx]              # same order as best_prediction

  # --- More summary metrics -----------------------------------------------
  rmse_after_final <- sqrt(mean((corrected_obs - true_obs)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  improvement_final <- rmse_before - rmse_after_final

  if (verbose) {
    cat(sprintf("Final model trained on all observed rows: RMSE after final correction = %.4f (Δ relative to before = %.4f)\n",
                rmse_after_final, improvement_final))
  }

  # --- Generate diagnostic plots ------------------------------------------
  # 1) Residual histograms before / after (OOF)
  plot_resid_df <- data.frame(
    type = rep(c("before", "after_oof"), each = n_obs),
    resid = c((preds_obs - true_obs), (oof_pred_residual - 0)) # note: before residual = pred - true; after_oof residual ~ corrected - true = (pred - pred_resid) - true = (pred - true) - pred_resid
  )
  # But easier: compare distribution of (pred - true) and (corrected - true)
  plot_resid_df2 <- data.frame(
    type = rep(c("before", "after_oof"), each = n_obs),
    value = c((preds_obs - true_obs), (oof_pred_corrected - true_obs))
  )

  p1 <- ggplot(plot_resid_df2, aes(x = value, fill = type)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.35) + labs(title = "Residual distribution: before vs OOF-corrected",
                                      x = "Residual (pred - true)", y = "Density") +
    theme_minimal()

  # 2) Scatter: predicted vs true (before and after OOF) — sample if many points
  plot_df_scatter <- data.frame(
    true = rep(true_obs, 2),
    pred = c(preds_obs, oof_pred_corrected),
    stage = rep(c("before", "after_oof"), each = n_obs)
  )
  p2 <- ggplot(plot_df_scatter, aes(x = true, y = pred, color = stage)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = "Predicted vs True: before vs OOF-corrected", x = "True", y = "Predicted") +
    theme_minimal()

  # 3) Improvement by top factor (if any factor vars exist among problem_vars)
  factor_vars_in_problem <- problem_vars[sapply(df_all[, problem_vars, drop = FALSE], is.factor) |
                                          sapply(df_all[, problem_vars, drop = FALSE], is.character)]
  p3 <- NULL
  if (length(factor_vars_in_problem) > 0) {
    top_factor <- factor_vars_in_problem[1]
    df_factor <- data.frame(
      level = as.character(df_all[obs_idx, top_factor]),
      before_err = preds_obs - true_obs,
      after_err_oof = oof_pred_corrected - true_obs
    )
    agg_df <- df_factor %>%
      group_by(level) %>%
      summarise(mean_before = mean(before_err, na.rm = TRUE),
                mean_after  = mean(after_err_oof, na.rm = TRUE),
                n = n()) %>%
      arrange(desc(abs(mean_before))) %>%
      filter(n >= 3)  # at least 3 observations per level for stable display

    if (nrow(agg_df) > 0) {
      agg_df_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(agg_df, cols = c("mean_before", "mean_after"),
                                         names_to = "stage", values_to = "mean_err")
      p3 <- ggplot(agg_df_long, aes(x = reorder(level, -abs(mean_err)), y = mean_err, fill = stage)) +
        geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
        labs(title = paste0("Mean residual by level of ", top_factor),
             x = paste0(top_factor, " (levels)"), y = "Mean residual (pred - true)") +
        theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    }
  }

  # --- Return a structured list -------------------------------------------
  out <- list(
    diagnostic = diagnostic,         # from analyse_bad_predictions (full-df aligned)
    problem_vars = problem_vars,     # predictors used by meta-model
    final_model = final_rf,          # final randomForest meta-model (trained on all observed rows)
    oof = list(
      residual_pred_oof = oof_pred_residual,   # predicted residuals, OOF, length n_obs
      corrected_pred_oof = oof_pred_corrected, # corrected predictions, OOF, length n_obs
      rmse_before = rmse_before,
      rmse_after_oof = rmse_after_oof,
      improvement_oof = improvement_oof
    ),
    final = list(
      corrected_full = corrected_full, # length n_all; NA where preds_full is NA
      corrected_obs = corrected_obs,   # length n_obs; same order as best_prediction
      rmse_after_final = rmse_after_final,
      improvement_final = improvement_final
    ),
    plots = list(resid_density = p1, pred_vs_true = p2, factor_improvement = p3),
    meta = list(k = k, ntree = ntree, nodesize = nodesize, seed = seed,
                problem_var_count = length(problem_vars))
  )

  return(out)
}


res <- refine_imputation_cv_rf(
  df_all = df_all,
  best_prediction = best_prediction,   # must have columns 'pred', 'true', 'index'
  predictors = names(df_all),          # or a subset of predictors
  target_var = "LotFrontage",
  k = 10,
  ntree = 100,
  nodesize = 5,
  numeric_top_n = 5,
  seed = 42,
  verbose = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
fe_engineering <- function(df,
                           collapse_factor_min = 5,
                           numeric_log = NULL,
                           numeric_sqrt = NULL,
                           poly_vars = NULL,        # named list: list(col = degree)
                           interactions = NULL,     # list of character vectors c("A","B")
                           binning = NULL,          # named list: list(col = c(cuts))
                           winsorize = NULL,        # named list: list(col = c(lower_pct, upper_pct))
                           one_hot = FALSE,
                           remove_original = FALSE) {
  # Purpose: create common FE transforms in-place and return metadata
  #
  # Returns: list(data = data.frame, meta = list(created = <vector>, mapping info...))
  #
  library(dplyr); library(forcats); library(tidyr)
  df2 <- as.data.frame(df)
  meta <- list(created = character(0), collapsed = list())

  # 1) collapse rare factor levels
  factor_cols <- names(df2)[sapply(df2, is.factor)]
  for (v in factor_cols) {
    tbl <- table(df2[[v]])
    rare <- names(tbl)[tbl < collapse_factor_min]
    if (length(rare) > 0) {
      df2[[v]] <- forcats::fct_collapse(df2[[v]], Other = rare)
      df2[[v]] <- droplevels(df2[[v]])
      meta$collapsed[[v]] <- rare
    }
  }

  # 2) winsorize numeric columns
  if (!is.null(winsorize)) {
    for (v in names(winsorize)) {
      p <- winsorize[[v]]
      if (!is.numeric(df2[[v]])) next
      lo <- quantile(df2[[v]], probs = p[1], na.rm = TRUE)
      hi <- quantile(df2[[v]], probs = p[2], na.rm = TRUE)
      newn <- paste0(v, "_winsor")
      df2[[newn]] <- pmin(pmax(df2[[v]], lo), hi)
      meta$created <- c(meta$created, newn)
    }
  }

  # 3) log / sqrt transforms
  if (!is.null(numeric_log)) {
    for (v in numeric_log) {
      if (!is.numeric(df2[[v]])) next
      newn <- paste0("log_", v)
      df2[[newn]] <- ifelse(!is.na(df2[[v]]) & df2[[v]] > 0, log(df2[[v]]), NA_real_)
      meta$created <- c(meta$created, newn)
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(numeric_sqrt)) {
    for (v in numeric_sqrt) {
      if (!is.numeric(df2[[v]])) next
      newn <- paste0("sqrt_", v)
      df2[[newn]] <- ifelse(!is.na(df2[[v]]), sqrt(pmax(df2[[v]], 0)), NA_real_)
      meta$created <- c(meta$created, newn)
    }
  }

  # 4) polynomial features
  if (!is.null(poly_vars)) {
    for (v in names(poly_vars)) {
      deg <- as.integer(poly_vars[[v]])
      if (!is.numeric(df2[[v]])) next
      for (d in 2:deg) {
        newn <- paste0(v, "_poly", d)
        df2[[newn]] <- ifelse(!is.na(df2[[v]]), df2[[v]]^d, NA_real_)
        meta$created <- c(meta$created, newn)
      }
    }
  }

  # 5) interactions (simple multiplicative interactions)
  if (!is.null(interactions)) {
    for (pair in interactions) {
      v1 <- pair[1]; v2 <- pair[2]
      if (! (v1 %in% names(df2) && v2 %in% names(df2))) next
      newn <- paste0(v1, "_x_", v2)
      df2[[newn]] <- ifelse(!is.na(df2[[v1]]) & !is.na(df2[[v2]]), df2[[v1]] * df2[[v2]], NA_real_)
      meta$created <- c(meta$created, newn)
    }
  }

  # 6) binning
  if (!is.null(binning)) {
    for (v in names(binning)) {
      if (!is.numeric(df2[[v]])) next
      cuts <- binning[[v]]
      newn <- paste0(v, "_binned")
      df2[[newn]] <- cut(df2[[v]], breaks = c(-Inf, cuts, Inf), include.lowest = TRUE)
      df2[[newn]] <- droplevels(df2[[newn]])
      meta$created <- c(meta$created, newn)
    }
  }

  # 7) optional one-hot encoding
  df_out <- df2
  if (one_hot) {
    mm <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = df2)
    df_out <- as.data.frame(mm)
  }

  # 8) remove originals if requested
  if (remove_original) {
    to_remove <- c(names(poly_vars), numeric_log, numeric_sqrt, names(binning), unlist(interactions))
    to_remove <- intersect(to_remove, names(df_out))
    df_out <- df_out[, setdiff(names(df_out), to_remove), drop = FALSE]
  }

  return(list(data = df_out, meta = meta))
}
```

```{r}
run_imputer_cv <- function(df,
                           target_var = "LotFrontage",
                           predictors = NULL,
                           methods = c("lm", "xgb", "lgb", "ranger"),
                           param_grids = NULL,         # list of param grids per method (see defaults below)
                           n_folds = 5,
                           n_repeats = 3,
                           mask_frac = 0.20,           # constant 20% masked per fold as requested
                           min_rows_train = 30,
                           seed = 123,
                           parallel = TRUE,
                           workers = NULL,
                           verbose = TRUE) {
  library(dplyr); library(purrr); library(tidyr)
  library(furrr); library(future)
  library(ranger); library(randomForest)
  library(xgboost); library(lightgbm)
  library(mgcv); # for GAM if you ever add gam to methods
  set.seed(seed)

  if (is.null(predictors)) predictors <- setdiff(names(df), target_var)
  if (!target_var %in% names(df)) stop("target_var not in df")

  # prepare default param grids if none supplied
  default_grids <- list(
    lm = expand.grid(dummy = NA),  # lm has no hyperparams
    xgb = expand.grid(eta = c(0.05, 0.1),
                      max_depth = c(3L, 5L),
                      nrounds = c(50L, 100L)),
    lgb = expand.grid(learning_rate = c(0.05, 0.1),
                      num_leaves = c(15L, 31L),
                      nrounds = c(50L, 100L)),
    ranger = expand.grid(num.trees = c(100L),
                         min.node.size = c(5L, 10L))
  )
  if (is.null(param_grids)) param_grids <- default_grids
  # ensure each requested method has a param grid
  for (m in methods) {
    if (!m %in% names(param_grids)) {
      if (m %in% names(default_grids)) param_grids[[m]] <- default_grids[[m]] else stop("No param grid for method ", m)
    }
  }

  # setup parallel plan
  if (parallel) {
    if (is.null(workers)) {
      workers <- max(1L, future::availableCores() - 1L)
    }
    plan(multisession, workers = workers)
    if (verbose) message("Parallel plan multisession with ", workers, " workers")
    use_future_map <- TRUE
  } else {
    plan(sequential)
    use_future_map <- FALSE
  }

  # helper: mask selection that preserves factor levels in train
  make_mask_indices <- function(known_idx, mask_frac, df_local, predictors_local, min_rows_train, max_attempts = 200) {
    mask_n <- max(1, round(length(known_idx) * mask_frac))
    attempt <- 1
    while (attempt <= max_attempts) {
      mask_try <- sample(known_idx, mask_n)
      train_idx <- setdiff(known_idx, mask_try)
      if (length(train_idx) < min_rows_train) { attempt <- attempt + 1; next }
      # ensure factors have >1 level in training
      ok <- TRUE
      for (f in predictors_local[sapply(df_local[, predictors_local, drop = FALSE], is.factor)]) {
        if (nlevels(droplevels(df_local[[f]][train_idx])) < 2) { ok <- FALSE; break }
      }
      if (ok) return(list(mask = mask_try, train = train_idx))
      attempt <- attempt + 1
    }
    return(NULL)
  }

  # get indices where target is observed
  obs_all_idx <- which(!is.na(df[[target_var]]))
  if (length(obs_all_idx) < (min_rows_train + 2)) stop("Not enough observed target rows to perform CV")

  # For results storage
  all_method_results <- list()

  # Iterate methods
  for (method in methods) {
    if (verbose) message("Evaluating method: ", method)
    grid <- param_grids[[method]]
    # make grid list of rows
    grid_list <- split(grid, seq_len(nrow(grid)))

    # evaluate each param combo with repeated masking CV
    eval_param_combo <- function(param_row) {
      params <- as.list(param_row)
      if (verbose) message("  combo: ", paste(names(params), params, collapse = ", "))
      # storage for OOF predictions and truths
      oof_preds <- rep(NA_real_, length(obs_all_idx))
      names(oof_preds) <- obs_all_idx
      truths <- df[[target_var]][obs_all_idx]
      # repeated masking
      for (rep_i in seq_len(n_repeats)) {
        for (fold_i in seq_len(n_folds)) {
          mask_out <- make_mask_indices(obs_all_idx, mask_frac = mask_frac, df_local = df, predictors_local = predictors, min_rows_train = min_rows_train)
          if (is.null(mask_out)) next
          mask_idx <- mask_out$mask
          train_idx <- mask_out$train

          # Build training dataframe (complete-case for chosen predictors)
          keep_idx <- c(train_idx, mask_idx)
          model_df <- df[keep_idx, c(target_var, predictors), drop = FALSE]
          # set masked values to NA
          model_df[[target_var]][match(mask_idx, keep_idx)] <- NA

          train_rows <- which(!is.na(model_df[[target_var]]))
          test_rows_rel <- which(is.na(model_df[[target_var]])) # relative to model_df
          if (length(train_rows) < min_rows_train) next

          # align factor levels for predictors within model_df
          for (p in predictors) {
            if (is.factor(model_df[[p]])) {
              levs <- levels(droplevels(model_df[[p]][train_rows]))
              model_df[[p]] <- factor(model_df[[p]], levels = levs)
            }
          }

          # prepare data for each method
          if (method == "lm") {
            form <- as.formula(paste(target_var, "~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))
            fit <- tryCatch(lm(form, data = model_df[train_rows, , drop = FALSE]), error = function(e) NULL)
            if (!is.null(fit)) {
              preds_rel <- tryCatch(predict(fit, newdata = model_df[test_rows_rel, , drop = FALSE]), error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(test_rows_rel)))
            } else preds_rel <- rep(NA_real_, length(test_rows_rel))
          } else if (method == "xgb") {
            mm_train <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = model_df[train_rows, predictors, drop = FALSE])
            mm_test  <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = model_df[test_rows_rel, predictors, drop = FALSE])
            dtrain <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(data = mm_train, label = model_df[[target_var]][train_rows])
            xgb_params <- list(objective = "reg:squarederror", eta = params$eta, max_depth = as.integer(params$max_depth))
            xgb_mod <- tryCatch(xgboost::xgb.train(params = xgb_params, data = dtrain, nrounds = as.integer(params$nrounds), verbose = 0), error = function(e) NULL)
            if (!is.null(xgb_mod)) {
              preds_rel <- tryCatch(predict(xgb_mod, mm_test), error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(mm_test)))
            } else preds_rel <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(mm_test))
          } else if (method == "lgb") {
            mm_train <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = model_df[train_rows, predictors, drop = FALSE])
            mm_test  <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = model_df[test_rows_rel, predictors, drop = FALSE])
            dtrain <- lightgbm::lgb.Dataset(data = mm_train, label = model_df[[target_var]][train_rows])
            lgb_params <- list(objective = "regression", learning_rate = params$learning_rate, num_leaves = as.integer(params$num_leaves))
            lgb_mod <- tryCatch(lightgbm::lgb.train(params = lgb_params, data = dtrain, nrounds = as.integer(params$nrounds), verbose = -1), error = function(e) NULL)
            if (!is.null(lgb_mod)) {
              preds_rel <- tryCatch(predict(lgb_mod, mm_test), error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(mm_test)))
            } else preds_rel <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(mm_test))
          } else if (method == "ranger") {
            # ranger supports factor predictors natively
            fit <- tryCatch(ranger::ranger(as.formula(paste(target_var, "~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))),
                                          data = model_df[train_rows, , drop = FALSE],
                                          num.trees = as.integer(params$num.trees),
                                          min.node.size = as.integer(params$min.node.size),
                                          verbose = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
            if (!is.null(fit)) {
              preds_rel <- tryCatch(predict(fit, data = model_df[test_rows_rel, , drop = FALSE])$predictions, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(test_rows_rel)))
            } else preds_rel <- rep(NA_real_, length(test_rows_rel))
          } else {
            preds_rel <- rep(NA_real_, length(test_rows_rel))
          }

          # put preds_rel into oof_preds at the absolute indices
          abs_test_idx <- keep_idx[test_rows_rel]
          for (j in seq_along(abs_test_idx)) {
            abs_idx <- abs_test_idx[j]
            oof_preds[as.character(abs_idx)] <- preds_rel[j]
          }

        } # end folds
      } # end repeats

      # compute metrics on oof_preds vs truths (only where both present)
      idx_ok <- which(!is.na(oof_preds))
      if (length(idx_ok) == 0) {
        rmse <- NA_real_; mae <- NA_real_; r2 <- NA_real_ ; n_ok <- 0
      } else {
        tvals <- truths[idx_ok]; pvals <- unname(oof_preds[idx_ok])
        rmse <- sqrt(mean((tvals - pvals)^2))
        mae <- mean(abs(tvals - pvals))
        r2 <- if (length(tvals) > 1) cor(tvals, pvals)^2 else NA_real_
        n_ok <- length(idx_ok)
      }

      list(params = params, rmse = rmse, mae = mae, r2 = r2, n = n_ok, oof_preds = oof_preds)
    } # end eval_param_combo

    # Parallel or serial mapping through grid_list
    if (use_future_map) {
      combos_res <- furrr::future_map(grid_list, eval_param_combo, .progress = verbose)
    } else {
      combos_res <- purrr::map(grid_list, eval_param_combo)
    }

    # pick best combo by rmse (lowest)
    rmses <- sapply(combos_res, function(x) x$rmse)
    best_idx <- which.min(rmses)
    best_combo_res <- combos_res[[best_idx]]

    # Fit final model on all observed rows using best params (to produce final imputations)
    observed_idx <- which(!is.na(df[[target_var]]))
    full_train_df <- df[observed_idx, c(target_var, predictors), drop = FALSE]
    for (p in predictors) {
      if (is.factor(full_train_df[[p]])) full_train_df[[p]] <- droplevels(full_train_df[[p]])
    }

    if (method == "lm") {
      final_fit <- tryCatch(lm(as.formula(paste(target_var, "~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))), data = full_train_df), error = function(e) NULL)
      final_preds_full <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
      if (!is.null(final_fit)) {
        rows_to_pred <- which(is.na(df[[target_var]])) # the originally-missing rows
        if (length(rows_to_pred) > 0) {
          newdata <- df[rows_to_pred, predictors, drop = FALSE]
          # align factor levels
          for (p in predictors) if (is.factor(full_train_df[[p]])) newdata[[p]] <- factor(newdata[[p]], levels = levels(full_train_df[[p]]))
          final_preds_full[rows_to_pred] <- tryCatch(predict(final_fit, newdata = newdata), error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(rows_to_pred)))
        }
      }
    } else if (method == "xgb") {
      mm_train <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = full_train_df[, predictors, drop = FALSE])
      dtrain <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(data = mm_train, label = full_train_df[[target_var]])
      bp <- best_combo_res$params
      xgb_params <- list(objective = "reg:squarederror", eta = bp$eta, max_depth = as.integer(bp$max_depth))
      final_fit <- tryCatch(xgboost::xgb.train(params = xgb_params, data = dtrain, nrounds = as.integer(bp$nrounds), verbose = 0), error = function(e) NULL)
      final_preds_full <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
      if (!is.null(final_fit)) {
        rows_to_pred <- which(is.na(df[[target_var]]))
        if (length(rows_to_pred) > 0) {
          mm_new <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = df[rows_to_pred, predictors, drop = FALSE])
          final_preds_full[rows_to_pred] <- tryCatch(predict(final_fit, mm_new), error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(rows_to_pred)))
        }
      }
    } else if (method == "lgb") {
      mm_train <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = full_train_df[, predictors, drop = FALSE])
      dtrain <- lightgbm::lgb.Dataset(data = mm_train, label = full_train_df[[target_var]])
      bp <- best_combo_res$params
      lgb_params <- list(objective = "regression", learning_rate = bp$learning_rate, num_leaves = as.integer(bp$num_leaves))
      final_fit <- tryCatch(lightgbm::lgb.train(params = lgb_params, data = dtrain, nrounds = as.integer(bp$nrounds), verbose = -1), error = function(e) NULL)
      final_preds_full <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
      if (!is.null(final_fit)) {
        rows_to_pred <- which(is.na(df[[target_var]]))
        if (length(rows_to_pred) > 0) {
          mm_new <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = df[rows_to_pred, predictors, drop = FALSE])
          final_preds_full[rows_to_pred] <- tryCatch(predict(final_fit, mm_new), error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(rows_to_pred)))
        }
      }
    } else if (method == "ranger") {
      bp <- best_combo_res$params
      final_fit <- tryCatch(ranger::ranger(as.formula(paste(target_var, "~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))),
                                          data = full_train_df,
                                          num.trees = as.integer(bp$num.trees),
                                          min.node.size = as.integer(bp$min.node.size),
                                          importance = "impurity"), error = function(e) NULL)
      final_preds_full <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
      if (!is.null(final_fit)) {
        rows_to_pred <- which(is.na(df[[target_var]]))
        if (length(rows_to_pred) > 0) {
          final_preds_full[rows_to_pred] <- tryCatch(predict(final_fit, data = df[rows_to_pred, predictors, drop = FALSE])$predictions, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(rows_to_pred)))
        }
      }
    } else {
      final_fit <- NULL
      final_preds_full <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
    }

    all_method_results[[method]] <- list(
      method = method,
      grid = grid,
      combos_res = combos_res,
      best_combo = best_combo_res,
      final_model = final_fit,
      final_imputations = final_preds_full
    )

  } # end methods loop

  # stop parallel plan
  plan(sequential)

  return(list(
    results_by_method = all_method_results,
    params = param_grids,
    meta = list(n_folds = n_folds, n_repeats = n_repeats, mask_frac = mask_frac)
  ))
}
```

```{r}
diagnose_residuals <- function(df_all,
                               bad_prediction,   # tibble with columns index, true, pred, abs_error
                               predictors,
                               p_thresh = 0.1,
                               rf_ntree = 200,
                               rf_min_node_size = 5,
                               seed = 123) {
  library(dplyr); library(broom); library(ggplot2); library(ranger)
  set.seed(seed)

  if (!all(c("index", "true", "pred") %in% names(bad_prediction))) stop("bad_prediction must have index,true,pred")
  bad_idx <- bad_prediction$index
  n_bad <- length(bad_idx)
  n_all <- nrow(df_all)
  other_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(n_all), bad_idx)

  text_lines <- c()
  # Numeric tests
  numeric_vars <- predictors[sapply(df_all[, predictors, drop = FALSE], is.numeric)]
  if (length(numeric_vars) > 0) {
    num_res <- lapply(numeric_vars, function(v) {
      bad_vals <- df_all[[v]][bad_idx]
      good_vals <- df_all[[v]][other_idx]
      # choose t-test if both >= 30 else wilcox
      use_t <- length(na.omit(bad_vals)) >= 30 && length(na.omit(good_vals)) >= 30
      test <- if (use_t) tryCatch(t.test(bad_vals, good_vals), error = function(e) NULL) else tryCatch(wilcox.test(bad_vals, good_vals), error = function(e) NULL)
      tibble::tibble(Variable = v,
                     mean_bad = mean(bad_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
                     mean_rest = mean(good_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
                     diff = mean_bad - mean_rest,
                     p_value = if (!is.null(test)) broom::tidy(test)$p.value else NA_real_)
    })
    num_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(num_res)
    top_num <- num_tbl %>% arrange(p_value) %>% head(6)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(top_num))) {
      text_lines <- c(text_lines, sprintf("- Numeric %s: mean_bad=%.2f, mean_rest=%.2f, Δ=%.2f, p=%.3g",
                                         top_num$Variable[i], top_num$mean_bad[i], top_num$mean_rest[i], top_num$diff[i], top_num$p_value[i]))
    }
  } else text_lines <- c(text_lines, "- No numeric predictors to test.")

  # Factor tests
  factor_vars <- predictors[sapply(df_all[, predictors, drop = FALSE], function(x) is.factor(x) || is.character(x))]
  if (length(factor_vars) > 0) {
    for (v in factor_vars) {
      full_tab <- table(df_all[[v]])
      bad_tab <- table(df_all[[v]][bad_idx])
      all_levels <- union(names(full_tab), names(bad_tab))
      full_tab <- full_tab[all_levels]; bad_tab <- bad_tab[all_levels]
      full_tab[is.na(full_tab)] <- 0; bad_tab[is.na(bad_tab)] <- 0
      p_vals <- sapply(all_levels, function(lvl) {
        bad_yes <- bad_tab[[lvl]]; bad_no <- sum(bad_tab) - bad_yes
        good_yes <- full_tab[[lvl]] - bad_yes; good_no <- sum(full_tab) - full_tab[[lvl]] - bad_no
        tbl <- matrix(c(bad_yes, bad_no, good_yes, good_no), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
        if (any(tbl < 5)) {
          test <- tryCatch(fisher.test(tbl)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
        } else {
          test <- tryCatch(chisq.test(tbl, correct = FALSE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
        }
        test
      })
      over_rep <- (bad_tab / sum(bad_tab)) - (full_tab / sum(full_tab))
      lvl_df <- tibble::tibble(level = all_levels, prop_bad = as.numeric(bad_tab / sum(bad_tab)),
                               prop_all = as.numeric(full_tab / sum(full_tab)), over = as.numeric(over_rep), p = p_vals)
      lvl_df <- lvl_df %>% arrange(p)
      sig <- lvl_df %>% filter(!is.na(p) & p < p_thresh)
      if (nrow(sig) > 0) {
        top <- sig %>% arrange(desc(over)) %>% slice_head(n = 1)
        text_lines <- c(text_lines, sprintf("- Factor %s: level '%s' over-represented (%.2f%% vs %.2f%%; p=%.3g)",
                                           v, top$level, 100*top$prop_bad, 100*top$prop_all, top$p))
      }
    }
  } else text_lines <- c(text_lines, "- No factor predictors to test.")

  # Train RF on residuals (pred - true) restricted to bad indices (if we have residuals)
  resid <- bad_prediction$pred - bad_prediction$true
  rf_plot <- ggplot() + ggtitle("Not enough rows to compute importance")
  if (length(resid) >= 10) {
    rf_df <- df_all[bad_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    rf_df$.resid <- resid
    rf_mod <- ranger::ranger(.resid ~ ., data = rf_df[, c(predictors, ".resid"), drop = FALSE],
                             num.trees = rf_ntree, min.node.size = rf_min_node_size, importance = "impurity")
    imp <- ranger::importance(rf_mod)
    imp_df <- tibble::tibble(variable = names(imp), importance = as.numeric(imp)) %>% arrange(desc(importance))
    rf_plot <- ggplot(imp_df[1:min(30, nrow(imp_df)), , drop = FALSE], aes(x = reorder(variable, importance), y = importance)) +
      geom_col() + coord_flip() + labs(title = "Feature importance for residuals (bad subset)", x = "variable", y = "importance") + theme_minimal()
  }

  text_summary <- if (length(text_lines) > 0) paste(text_lines, collapse = "\n") else "No significant structural differences detected."

  list(text_summary = text_summary, numeric_table = if (exists("num_tbl")) num_tbl else NULL,
       factor_checks = NULL, importance_plot = rf_plot)
}
```

```{r}
# small example param grids (override defaults for speed)
param_grids_custom <- list(
  lm = data.frame(dummy = NA),
  xgb = expand.grid(eta = c(0.05,0.1), max_depth = c(3L), nrounds = c(50L)),
  lgb = expand.grid(learning_rate = c(0.05), num_leaves = c(15L), nrounds = c(50L)),

)

  df = train_csv,
  target_var = "LotFrontage",
  predictors = setdiff(names(train_csv), "LotFrontage"),
  methods = c("lm","xgb","lgb","ranger"),
  param_grids = param_grids_custom,
  n_folds = 5,
  n_repeats = 3,

)

res_cv$results_by_method$xgb$best_combo$rmse   # best combo summary RMSE
```

Missing data is present in the MSZoning, LotFrontage, Alley, Utilities, Exterior1st, Exterior2nd, MasVnrType, MasVnrArea, BsmtQual, BsmtCond, BsmtExposure, BsmtFinType1, BsmtFinSF1, BsmtFinType2, BsmtFinSF2, BsmtUnfSF, TotalBsmtSF, BsmtFullBath, BsmtHalfBath, KitchenQual, Functional, FireplaceQu, GarageType, GarageYrBlt, GarageFinish, GarageCars, GarageArea, GarageQual, GarageCond, PoolQC, Fence, MiscFeature, SaleType
For the sake of consistency, we will use broadly the same methods as used in the training dataset to impute the missing values in the test dataset.
